meta.revisionPolicy: Revised continuously; finalised over ~3 years. Vintages are kept.
meta.coverage: All-India, annual: every published estimate stage of every year (first and second advance, provisional, first, second and third revised, final, additional revision), levels of each national-accounts total and MoSPI's own growth rate at each stage
meta.note: Levels as the API holds each stage today: a later release can restate a stage under its old label (on 31 Aug 2026 MoSPI updated every 2022-23-base year for the new PPI and IIP; 2025-26 Provisional moved from Rs 3,23,12,034 to 3,24,70,100 crore at constant prices), so a stage here is the latest figure carrying that label, not every figure ever printed. Growth at each stage (gdp_growth_*, gva_growth_*) is computed from levels against the previous year's stage that reproduces MoSPI's published rate within 0.1 point (meta.pairs names it for every date); MoSPI's own one-decimal rates, which are sometimes truncated rather than rounded, are kept as *_published. First, latest and revision are computed from the growth series. The industry-by-stage detail is in the raw dump (data/raw/nas-deep-*-current-annual.json) and the deep archive.
